info.description:
REST API of **MecaTrack**, a booking and vehicle-tracking system for a car repair workshop.

* **Errors** always use the same JSON body: `{"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": ...}`.
* **Authentication** is a session cookie. In Swagger UI, call `POST /auth/login` first
  (for example with `carlos.owner@tallermecanico.com` / `test1234`, the test owner listed in the README);
  the browser keeps the cookie and sends it on the following requests.
* **Roles**: reading the catalog is public; creating, replacing or deleting services
  requires the `owner` or `admin` role, and so does the open-data market panel (`/api/v1/market`).

base_price.description: Base price in COP, integer between 0 and 100,000,000.

description.description: Free-text description of the vehicle problem, as the customer would say it (10-1000 chars).
description.example: El carro vibra cuando freno en bajada

technique.description: Prompting technique: zero_shot, few_shot (default) or cot (chain-of-thought).

service_id.description: Catalog id of the suggested service.

service_name.description: Service name, read from the database.

base_price.description: Base price in COP, read from the database (never generated by the model).

estimated_duration_minutes.description: Estimated duration in minutes, read from the database.

reason.description: Short justification written by the model in the language of the customer.
reason.example: La vibracion al frenar suele indicar discos alabeados.

strategy.description: Retrieval strategy used to build the context (keyword matching).

fallback_full_catalog.description: True when no keyword matched and the whole active catalog was sent as context.

candidate_service_ids.description: Services injected into the prompt as context, best match first.

thinking_tokens.description: Internal reasoning tokens (billed as output by Gemini); 0 if the model did not think.

latency_ms.description: End-to-end time of the provider call in milliseconds, retries included.

attempts.description: Number of attempts (more than 1 when a 429/503 was retried).

ai_call_id.description: Id of the row stored in the ai_calls log.

suggestions.description: Up to 3 suggested services, most likely first. Empty if nothing in the catalog fits.

example.reason: La vibracion al frenar suele indicar discos alabeados.

notes.description: Extra advice from the model, e.g. safety warnings. May be empty.
notes.example: Los frenos son un tema de seguridad; agenda pronto.

reasoning.description: Step-by-step analysis written by the model; only filled with technique=cot, otherwise null.
reasoning.example: 1) Sistema de frenos. 2) Discos alabeados por calor. 3) Rectificacion de discos.

discarded_service_ids.description: Ids the model proposed that were NOT in the context (hallucinations), removed by the API.

retrieval.description: How the catalog context was retrieved (RAG).

usage.description: Token usage and latency of the call.

fetched_at.description: Last successful download (UTC), null if never downloaded.

name.description: External dependency (host) protected by the breaker.

state.description: CLOSED (calls pass), OPEN (calls rejected) or HALF_OPEN (one trial call allowed).

consecutive_failures.description: Failures in a row counted by the breaker.

failure_threshold.description: Failures in a row that open the circuit.

recovery_timeout_s.description: Seconds OPEN before allowing a trial call.

retry_in_s.description: Seconds until the next trial call (only when OPEN).

sources.description: Open-data sources and their last snapshot.

circuits.description: Circuit breaker of each external host.

circuit_open.description: True if rejected because the circuit is OPEN.

results.description: One result per source; a failing source does not stop the others.

key.description: Key of the value inside each row.

type.description: 'number' or 'text', to align and format the cell.

sql.description: Exact DuckDB SQL that produced the rows (for transparency).

put.description:
Replaces every editable field of the service. This is a full
replacement, not a partial update: omitted optional fields go back to
their defaults. To retire a service that already has appointments,
send `status: inactive`. Requires an `owner` or `admin` session.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a service that has never been booked. If any
appointment references it the API answers 409, because deleting it
would orphan those appointments; deactivate it with PUT
(`status: inactive`) instead. Requires an `owner` or `admin` session.

post.description:
The customer describes a vehicle problem in free text and the
assistant suggests up to 3 services of the workshop catalog.
Retrieval-augmented generation: the API first retrieves the relevant
catalog services by keyword, injects them into the prompt and asks the
model to choose ONLY among them. Prices and durations come from the
database, never from the model. Every call is stored in `ai_calls`.
Any logged-in user can call it, up to `AI_MAX_CALLS_PER_HOUR` times per hour.

post.description:
Calls every source through the resilient HTTP client: transient
failures (timeouts, connection errors, HTTP 429/5xx) are retried with
exponential backoff and jitter, and each host has a circuit breaker
(3 consecutive failures open it for 30 s). A failing source does not
stop the others and keeps its previous snapshot. Always answers 200;
check `ok` per source. Requires an `owner` or `admin` session.

active fleet per class (cars, motorcycles, trucks, vans), with
descriptive statistics weighted by number of vehicles: mean, standard
deviation, min, P25, median, P75, P90, max and share of vehicles with
10+ years. Registrations before 1950 are excluded as data errors.
